Never use the crate as a punishment, because the second it feels like jail, it stops being their safe place. And when you leave or come home, keep it boring, no big hellos or goodbyes, so being alone doesn’t feel like a big deal. Puppies hold their pee about one hour for every month of age, so a two-month-old needs a break every two hours.
